body: PID7700 rendered the seed42 procedural colored triangle after cancelling two native terrain shader compiler errors (division by zero, pbr_terrain and pbr_terrain_gbuffer). ReadyToRender=true/loading_finished at ticks60 and1200. Optimization and scene.CheckResources(false) were added following official call sites. Rendering without error dialogs and native query behavior remain to prove. In the same process, rewriting one indexed owned navigation file in sequence43/42/43 imported two faces each time, with expected changing heights and successful 10-unit routes across both faces. Evidence navigation-probe-7700.json, render-probe-7700-42.json and render-observation-7700.json. Full epic incomplete, backend not accepted.
